title: One box's verdict (implementation-assessor)
description: How far the org's linked metadata implements one step of the design, with what is supported, what is missing, the sticky note, and the evidence.

verdict.description: supported: every part of the step the design states is done by the linked metadata. partial: some of it is. not-supported: none of it is, or the metadata does something else.

supported.description: What the org does for the step, one line each, naming the component.

missing.description: What the design asks that the org does not do, one line each.

note.description: partial or not-supported: the sticky note, what is missing in plain words, within the pack's noteMaxWords. Empty for supported.

nodeId.description: A component the pack lists: its nodeId, or for a component the org lacks (missingInOrg) the pack's missing: id.

what.description: What it shows, in one sentence.

gaps.description: What the verdict could not see: explanations that failed, definitions missing or cut, rows not shown.
